findings.failure_path: `claude plugin marketplace add "$HTTP_URL" 2>&1 | tail -1 || record_failure "$?"` (and the identical codex lines) replaces the previous `|| true`. Re-running install.sh to refresh an existing installation — the documented update flow — makes `marketplace add` fail because the marketplace is already registered, so the script now prints "部分安装失败；已完成的安装未回滚" and exits nonzero on an otherwise fully successful idempotent re-run. No test covers re-running against an already-registered marketplace.
findings.smallest_fix: Treat an already-registered marketplace as success, e.g. capture the output and only call record_failure when it does not indicate the marketplace/plugin already exists, or keep `|| true` for the `marketplace add` steps and record failures only for `plugin install` / `plugin add`.

findings.failure_path: sync_commands drops `rm -f "$dst_root"/ccl-*.md` and only copies the current ccl-*.md set. A package command that is later renamed or removed stays in ~/.config/opencode/commands (and .opencode/commands) forever, so users keep invoking a stale command that no longer matches the shipped assets, with no uninstall path from this installer.
findings.smallest_fix: Remove only the previously installed package command names (e.g. track them in the install manifest and delete that recorded set) before copying, instead of either the old unconditional ccl-*.md wipe or the new no-op.

findings.failure_path: The `if (!current.host) return {...current.hostFailure, ...}` guard was moved above the `!manifest && !current.plugin && !current.marketplace` check. `ccl-skills uninstall --host claude` on a machine where nothing was ever installed and the Claude CLI is absent now returns code 4 host-missing instead of the previous code 0 "absent", turning a correct no-op into a scripted failure. No test in the diff pins the absent+missing-CLI ordering.
findings.smallest_fix: Keep the host-failure guard but let the true-absent case win first: when there is no manifest and the probe kind is "missing", return the existing `{code: 0, status: "absent"}` result before returning hostFailure.

concern_results.conclusion: The probe refactor is coherent: probeHostVersion replaces three ad-hoc `--version` spawns, and claude/opencode/codex adapters all map its failure kinds to host-<kind> results. opencode doctor now reuses preflight() so mode, entry-set and symlink-parent drift are detected, and installOrUpdate still short-circuits to doctor() on an identical version+snapshotHash, so the diff's `shared-drift` assertions for install/update are reachable. package.json/package-lock are consistently bumped to 0.15.1. One behavior change is not covered by acceptance: claude uninstall now returns the host failure before the `absent` check, so `uninstall --host claude` on a machine with nothing installed and no CLI returns 4 instead of 0.

No accidental write path found. assertExclusiveRoot now also rejects a symlinked snapshots/ dir; preflight asserts safe shared parents for the OLD entry set before any retirement delete, closing the delete-through-symlink path (test covers it). The installer moves replaced directories aside rather than rm -rf, retries reuse `.retry.$BACKUP_STAMP` instead of clobbering the first saved copy, and rotation only rm -rf's names matching the installer stamp regex, so user-created backup names survive. Manifest writes are mktemp+mv so a failed write cannot truncate a prior receipt. The plugin's completedSkill requires byte-identical directory content against the active runtime skill before granting `ccl-skills:<name>` ownership, so a same-named external skill cannot be promoted by caller argument.

Timeout/ENOENT/other spawn errors are distinguished and propagated; SIGKILL killSignal prevents a SIGTERM-swallowing child from blocking. Post-uninstall probe failure returns code 5 partial and retains ownership evidence rather than deleting the root. runHostSequence still preserves 5/130 as terminal and stops later hosts. Installer functions now propagate `|| return "$?"` throughout and finish_backups failure is reported as a non-silent exit 1 after content changed. Residual: install-opencode.sh iterates "${BACKUP_ROOTS[@]}" under set -u; that is only safe because every reachable path appends at least one root before finish_backups (bash 3.2 would error on a genuinely empty array).

Tests are mutation-sensitive in the places that matter: the probe-timeout suite asserts wall-clock < 13.5s, absence of the child's late side-effect, ESRCH for the killed pid, and that no owned receipt was rewritten — all of which fail if the timeout/kill behavior is removed. host-adapters adds symlinked-snapshots, mode-drift, extra-file and symlink-parent cases asserting the manifest and user files are untouched. test_install_status.py includes an explicit meta-test that mutates the stamp regex and the retry-preservation branch and asserts exactly the named assertion fails. Gap: no test asserts the new claude `uninstall` ordering for the absent+missing-CLI case, and no test exercises re-running install.sh against an already-registered marketplace.

parsePluginList accepting SOURCE alongside PATH keeps older/newer Codex column layouts working while still returning unknown (not absent) for unrecognized headers. checkHost now returns kinds beyond missing/old; the packet shows the codex doctor consumer rendering host-timeout generically, so this appears handled. Two compatibility regressions are visible in the diff: install.sh no longer tolerates an already-present marketplace, and sync_commands no longer prunes stale ccl-*.md.

0.15.1 is patch metadata only; nothing in the diff publishes or tags. Rollback story for the installer is directory-level recovery copies retained until an install completes, and failure-period user additions are preserved (covered by the partial-copy retry test). The candidate correctly does not claim publication authority; the release claim depends on the rebuilt-artifact and temporary-HOME smoke evidence, which is asserted in the profile and cannot be re-verified from this packet.

Unknown observation is kept distinct from proven absence: probe kinds surface as host-timeout / host-probe-failed with the underlying errno in the message, and uninstall explicitly says state is unverified while retaining evidence. opencode doctor now reports both drifted paths and a `reason` for structural refusals. Installer failure messages tell the user the install is not rolled back and that recovery copies must be kept. The one operator-visible gap is that when a copy fails mid-run the replaced skill directory has already been moved into .ccl-skills-backup/.pending and the failure message does not name that path.

The shared-gate boundary (writes into user-shared OpenCode dirs and native registration state) is contained: exclusive-root canonicality, symlink refusal on base/root/snapshots, safe-parent assertion for both old and new entry sets, drift refusal before any mutation, and no force/repair/re-adopt escape hatch was added. Registration removal now hard-fails when host state cannot be observed instead of assuming absence, which is the correct direction for this boundary. No waiver path introduced.
